data.narrative:
Zeno Power is a Series B aerospace company founded by Tyler Bernstein, Jonathan Segal, and Jake Matthews, having raised $50M to date. The valuation framework draws on a comparable universe of 5 public Space & Aerospace equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two valuation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to $50M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yields $95M. Peer-median analysis across the 5 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $1.5B, with a range spanning $1.1B (Skyryse) to $8.0B (Sierra Space). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples—the sector median stands at 26.4x across the 6 public tickers—could not be applied due to the absence of Zeno Power's revenue on file.

The triangulated valuation range is $81M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $798M. This wide dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty: stage-progression methodology produces a substantially lower result than peer-median analysis, driven by the heterogeneity within the Space & Aerospace peer set and the stage disparity among comparables (Series B versus Series C). Resolution of this gap depends on clarification of Zeno Power's revenue trajectory and technical progress relative to the Sierra Space and Cowboy Space Corporation cohort.
